book.name: LUCAS
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U LUCAS Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Lucas tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Ni tal u txꞌiꞌlanaj uvaꞌ la paavin u Jesús

As atik itxumbꞌal u Jesús taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu tiꞌ ibꞌanat Aak kam uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ ste. As el veꞌt chꞌuꞌl Aak tziꞌ u nimla aꞌeꞌ u Jordán. As oon veꞌt Aak tu u tzuukin txꞌavaꞌeꞌ taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu.
As kaꞌviinqil qꞌii kat atin u Jesús tu u tzuukin tzꞌavaꞌeꞌ. As yeꞌl Aak kat txꞌaꞌni. Pet kat ikuy veꞌt Aak ivaꞌy. As kat ul veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ tiꞌ ul ichukat txumbꞌal tiꞌ uvaꞌ la paavin u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanaj ileꞌ: —Asoj axh iKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ, as ala uvaꞌ la bꞌen u kꞌubꞌeꞌ stxꞌixil,— tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ech ni tal viyol u Tiixh ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Jit kuxh u txꞌixeꞌ la isbꞌaꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
Pet kajayil chit unqꞌa iyol u Tiixheꞌ, as aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ la isbꞌaꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,—

content: tiꞌk u Jesús.
As bꞌen veꞌt u Jesús taꞌn u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ viꞌ umaꞌl u nimla vitz. As kam chit unqꞌa veeꞌ at tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil vatz u txꞌavaꞌeꞌ, as ikꞌuch veꞌt naj te u Jesús.

As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ: —As la voksa veꞌt axh sibꞌooqꞌolil unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil. As la vaqꞌ unqꞌa itxꞌiibꞌal iqꞌiieꞌ see, tan at tunqꞌabꞌ skajayil. As la uch vaqꞌat te umaj uxhchil, abꞌil uveꞌ la unsaꞌ vaqꞌat ste.
Asoj la kuꞌ axh qaaloj sunvatz tiꞌ ooksat unqꞌii, as eetzeꞌ uveꞌ skajayil,— tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ te u Jesús.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Jetzꞌen el sunvatz, Satanás, tan ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Taꞌn kuxh u Tiixheꞌ, vaBꞌooqꞌoleꞌ, la kuꞌ axh qaaloj svatz.

content: tiꞌk u Jesús.
As teqꞌo veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ u Jesús viꞌ u tostiixheꞌ tu u Jerusalén. As ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ te Aak: —Asoj axh iKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ, as suti kuꞌ eebꞌ tzitzaꞌ,
tan ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: La ichaj tzan u Tiixheꞌ unqꞌa ángel tiꞌ ul ilochat axh.
As: La ul ikꞌul axh unqꞌa ángel aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la kꞌaxbꞌu veꞌt avoj tiꞌ umaj kꞌubꞌ,—

content: tiꞌk u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —Ech ni tal umaꞌt u yol ileꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan:

content.text: Yeꞌ la uch abꞌekꞌat u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ,—

content: tiꞌk u Jesús.

As tul kat tzojpu veꞌt u txꞌiꞌlanajeꞌ tiꞌ ichukat txumbꞌal tiꞌ ikuꞌ u Jesús tu paav, as taqꞌ veꞌt kan naj u Jesús. As nik kuxh itxꞌebꞌ veꞌt naj ilejat umaꞌtoj qꞌii tiꞌ ichukat txumbꞌal unpajte tiꞌ u Jesús.
Nixeꞌt u Jesús chusun tu u Galilea
As atik itxumbꞌal u Jesús taꞌn u Tiixhla Espíritu tul qꞌaav veꞌt Aak tu u Galilea. As pax veꞌt itzibꞌlal u Jesús tulaj unqꞌa tenameꞌ tukꞌ tulaj unqꞌa talaj tenameꞌ.
As nikat ichusun veꞌt u Jesús tulaj unqꞌa atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh taꞌn unqꞌa tiaal Israel. As nimal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ nik oksan veꞌt iqꞌii Aak.
Ni tixval veꞌt u Jesús tu u Nazaret

As oon veꞌt u Jesús tu u Nazaret uvaꞌ chꞌiikat Aak. As tul kat ilej u xeem qꞌiieꞌ, as ok veꞌt Aak tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh, tan ech chit nik ibꞌan Aak tu jun xeem qꞌii. As txakebꞌ veꞌt Aak tiꞌ isikꞌlet Aak viyol u Tiixheꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
As aqꞌpik veꞌt ok u uꞌujeꞌ te Aak uveꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Isaías, u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ tul ijaj veꞌt Aak u uꞌujeꞌ. As ilej veꞌt Aak u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: Aꞌ viTiixhla Espíritu u Kubꞌaaleꞌ ni lochon in tiꞌ unbꞌanataꞌ kam uvaꞌ ni tal Aak sviꞌ.
As txaael veꞌt in taꞌn Aak tiꞌ valat unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ xoꞌl unqꞌa meebꞌaꞌeꞌ.
As kat ichaj veꞌt tzan in Aak tiꞌ ilochax unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌaxbꞌinal u taanxelaleꞌ taꞌn u paaveꞌ,
as tiꞌ valat unqꞌa yoleꞌ tiꞌ ichajpul veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ kꞌalel taꞌn u paaveꞌ,
as la ilon veꞌt unqꞌa tzoteꞌ,
as tiꞌ unqꞌalput unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ bꞌuchel kuxhtuꞌ taꞌn vipaaveꞌ,
as tiꞌ valat te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat ilejlu veꞌt u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ la taqꞌ veꞌt Aak vibꞌaꞌnileꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ isikꞌle u Jesús tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh.

content: As tul bꞌaꞌnxi, as ibꞌalqꞌu veꞌt Aak u uꞌujeꞌ. As taqꞌ veꞌt ok Aak te u lochonaaleꞌ. As xonebꞌ veꞌt Aak. As kaꞌyamalik chit veꞌt Aak taꞌn unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil uveꞌ atik tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh.
As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —As cheel kat ibꞌanlu veꞌt u veeꞌ sevatz, uvaꞌ alel kan tu u uꞌujeꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.

As achaꞌv chit viyol Aakeꞌ te unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As teqꞌo veꞌt taama unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ u yoleꞌ uveꞌ isikꞌle Aak. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa tenam ileꞌ: —¿Jit kol vikꞌaol u Xhuꞌleꞌ qꞌa u najeꞌ?— tiꞌk unqꞌa tenameꞌ tal svatzaj.

Ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Pet ni vitzꞌa uvaꞌ ech tuk etal ileꞌ sve: «¡Axh aatzꞌak, tzꞌaka eebꞌ sajunal!» chaj ex tuk etal sve. As moj ech la etal ileꞌ: «Jankꞌal unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ ni qabꞌi yol stiꞌ uvaꞌ kat abꞌan tu u Capernaúm as echat abꞌan tzitzaꞌ tu vatenameꞌ cheel,» chaj ex,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ unpajte: —Tan echeꞌ bꞌaꞌn koj iyolbꞌel umaꞌl u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ vatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tu vitenameꞌ.
As jik chit tuk val sete, tul uvaꞌ jit ul jabꞌal tu oxvaꞌl yaabꞌ tukꞌ vaajil ichꞌ taꞌn u Elías, as mamaꞌla vaꞌy kat ibꞌana. As kꞌuxh nimal unqꞌa txakay ixojeꞌ atik tu u Israel,
as jit ichaj bꞌen u Tiixheꞌ u Elías xeꞌ umaj txakay ixoj tu u Israel. Pet aꞌ ichajkat bꞌen Aak u Elías xeꞌ umaꞌl u txakay ixoj tu u Sarepta uvaꞌ echen tu u Sidón.

As kꞌuxh nimal unqꞌa aachꞌoꞌmeꞌ atike uvaꞌ atik ok chꞌaꞌk chin stiꞌ tu u Israel tul uvaꞌ atik u Eliseo, u qꞌajsan tetz viyol u Tiixheꞌ, as yeꞌxhebꞌil kat bꞌaꞌnxi. Pet taꞌn kuxh u Naamán, u aa Siria, kat bꞌaꞌnxi,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As tul tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ viyol u Jesús tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh, as ul veꞌt iviꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ Aak.

As imol veꞌt ok tibꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ Aak tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh. As tilul veꞌt el Aak tiꞌeꞌl u tenameꞌ. As eqꞌol veꞌt jeꞌ Aak viꞌ u vitzeꞌ uvaꞌ jejlikkat unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tan aꞌ tal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ la sutil bꞌen Aak vatz u vitzeꞌ.
Pet pal kuxh veꞌt Aak xoꞌl unqꞌa tenameꞌ. As bꞌen veꞌt Aak.
Ni teesa el u Jesús subꞌul tiꞌ umaꞌl u naj
As oon veꞌt u Jesús tu u Capernaúm uvaꞌ echen tu u Galilea. As tu u xeem qꞌiieꞌ tu jun xhemaana nikat ichus veꞌt Aak unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ.
As teqꞌo veꞌt taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ u chusbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ nik tal Aak, tan nik ikꞌuch Aak tukꞌ viyoloneꞌ uvaꞌ atik tijleꞌm Aak.
As atik ok umaꞌl u naj tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh uvaꞌ atik ok subꞌul skꞌatz. As taqꞌ jeꞌ naj tuul iviꞌ tiꞌ isikꞌineꞌ.

Ech tal veꞌt naj ileꞌ taꞌn u subꞌuleꞌ: —¡Jesús, aa Nazaret! ¿Kam asaꞌ sqe? ¡Yeꞌ ul ayansa oꞌ! Tan ootzimal svaꞌn uvaꞌ axheꞌ uvaꞌ chajel tzan axh taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ. As ayaꞌl chit akꞌuꞌl nooksa aama tiꞌ Aak,— tiꞌk u najeꞌ taꞌn u subꞌuleꞌ.

Ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te u subꞌuleꞌ: —¡Chaa tziꞌ! ¡Elen tiꞌ u najeꞌ!— tiꞌk Aak. As isuti veꞌt bꞌen u subꞌuleꞌ u najeꞌ tu txꞌavaꞌ vatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ. As el veꞌt u subꞌuleꞌ tiꞌ u najeꞌ. As jit ikꞌaxbꞌisa u subꞌuleꞌ u najeꞌ.

As kat teqꞌo veꞌt taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ skajayil tiꞌ uveꞌ ibꞌan u Jesús. As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchil ileꞌ svatzaj: —¿Kam tijleꞌm viyol u najeꞌ uveꞌ ni taleꞌ? Tan tul ni tal naj tel unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ kꞌatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as ninima unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ viyol najeꞌ,— tiꞌk unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As ipaxsa veꞌt unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ itzibꞌlal u Jesús tulaj unqꞌa talaj tenameꞌ uvaꞌ najlike.
Nibꞌaꞌnxisa u Jesús vijiꞌ u Luꞌeꞌ
El veꞌt chꞌuꞌl u Jesús tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh. As ok veꞌt Aak tu vikabꞌal u Simón uvaꞌ Luꞌ. As jajpu veꞌt bꞌaꞌnil te Aak tiꞌ vijiꞌ u Luꞌeꞌ, tan nimxinalik chit veꞌteꞌ taꞌn xamal chꞌoꞌm.

As jetzꞌen veꞌt ok Aak kꞌatz u aachꞌoꞌmeꞌ. As iyaa veꞌt Aak u xamal chꞌoꞌmeꞌ. As yak kuxh el veꞌt u xamal chꞌoꞌmeꞌ kꞌatz vijiꞌ u Luꞌeꞌ. As oora chit txakpu veꞌteꞌ. As taqꞌ veꞌt techbꞌubꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
Nimal aachꞌoꞌm nibꞌaꞌnxisa u Jesús

As tul maꞌtik ibꞌen veꞌt qꞌii, as teqꞌo veꞌt tzan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ unqꞌa aachꞌoꞌmeꞌ vatz u Jesús, kꞌuxh kam kuxh chꞌoꞌmil nik bꞌanon. As junun taqꞌat veꞌt jeꞌ Aak iqꞌabꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa aachꞌoꞌmeꞌ. As nikat ibꞌaꞌnx veꞌteꞌ.

As tul nikat tel unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ kꞌatz unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ, as vaꞌlik chit isikꞌin u subꞌuleꞌ tiꞌ teleꞌ. Ech nik tal ileꞌ te u Jesús: —¡Axheꞌ viKꞌaol u Tiixheꞌ!— tiꞌk unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ. As iyaa veꞌt u Jesús unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ, tan yeꞌ nisaꞌ Aak uvaꞌ la yolon u subꞌuleꞌ tan ootzimalik taꞌn u subꞌuleꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ u Jesús u Cristo.
Nipaxsa u Jesús viyol u Tiixheꞌ tu u Galilea

As tul sajbꞌu veꞌteꞌ, as bꞌex ichuk u Jesús umaꞌl u atinbꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌlkat uxhchil. As nik ichukun veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ Aak. As tul ilej unqꞌa tenameꞌ Aak, as ijaj veꞌt kuybꞌal te Aak tiꞌ uvaꞌ la kaaik kan Aak tu u tenameꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Yeꞌle, tan techal chiteꞌ uvaꞌ la bꞌen unpaxsa u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ te unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ at u tenameꞌ jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ, tan estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ichaj tzan in Aak,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As bꞌex tal veꞌt Aak u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tu unqꞌa atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh tulaj unqꞌa talaj tenameꞌ tu u Galilea.
